Good but expensive lunch at this Danang fish/seafood restaurant
Apr 2026 • Couples
We were taken by our driver in Danang. A whole range of fish and seafood to choose from in tanks. We had some clams, which were reasonably priced. When it came to choosing a fish, there were no options for smaller fish serving one person. We ended up with a pomfret weighing around a kilo for 1 million VND. The clams were stir fried with chili and were absolutely stunning. The fish was good. Our complaint is that there was too much of it. Staff were helpful in showing us how to deal with the fish.

TOURIST TRAP- DISHONEST PRICING
Dec 2024 • Family
Beware of this tourist trap! They employ highly dishonest pricing practices, charging more than three times the average prices in the area.

I nearly fell for it until I insisted they weigh the crabs in front of me for transparency. That’s when I discovered they were charging per 100g. Shockingly, three small crabs ended up costing $30 USD.

When I confronted them, they offered a laughable 5% discount, which only added insult to injury. The audacity was truly remarkable. Proceed with caution if you’re in the area!

I left and went down the street to a local spot that had a Michelin bib. 1000% transparent in pricing and gave us good-faith recommendations
